sentences.arabic: اِنْتَبِهْ، النَّهْرُ عَمِيقٌ جِدًّا هُنَا
sentences.transliteration: intabih, an-nahru 3ameequn jiddan hunaa

sentences.arabic: الْمَكْتَبَةُ هَادِئَةٌ، لَكِنَّ الصَّوْتَ فِي الشَّارِعِ عَالٍ
sentences.transliteration: al-maktabatu haadi2atun, laakinna as-sawta fee ash-shaari3i 3aalin

sentences.arabic: هَلِ الطِّفْلُ نَائِمٌ أَمْ مَا زَالَ مُسْتَيْقِظًا؟
sentences.transliteration: hali at-tiflu naa2imun am maa zaala mustayqizaa?

sentences.arabic: غُرْفَتُكَ مُبَعْثَرَةٌ، اِجْعَلْهَا مُرَتَّبَةً مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
sentences.transliteration: ghurfatuka muba3tharatun, ij3alhaa murattabatan min fadlik

sentences.arabic: هَذَا السُّوقُ الْقَدِيمُ مَشْهُورٌ جِدًّا وَشَعْبِيٌّ عِنْدَ الزُّوَّارِ
sentences.transliteration: haadhaa as-sooqu al-qadeemu mashhoorun jiddan wa sha3biyyun 3inda az-zuwwaar

sentences.arabic: الْفِكْرَةُ بَسِيطَةٌ لَكِنَّهَا مُفِيدَةٌ جِدًّا
sentences.transliteration: al-fikratu baseetatun laakinnahaa mufeedatun jiddaa

sentences.arabic: كَانَ الدَّرْسُ الْأَوَّلُ سَهْلًا، لَكِنَّ الثَّانِيَ كَانَ صَعْبًا
sentences.transliteration: kaana ad-darsu al-awwalu sahlan, laakinna ath-thaaniya kaana sa3baa

sentences.arabic: سَيَّارَتِي بَطِيئَةٌ، وَسَيَّارَتُهُ سَرِيعَةٌ
sentences.transliteration: sayyaaratee batee2atun, wa sayyaaratuhu saree3a

sentences.arabic: ضَعِ الْمَلَابِسَ الْمُتَّسِخَةَ هُنَا وَالنَّظِيفَةَ هُنَاكَ
sentences.transliteration: da3i al-malaabisa al-muttasikhata hunaa wan-nazeefata hunaak

sentences.arabic: هَلِ الْوُقُوفُ مَسْمُوحٌ هُنَا، أَمْ هُوَ مَمْنُوعٌ؟
sentences.transliteration: hali al-wuqoofu masmoo7un hunaa, am huwa mamnoo3?

sentences.arabic: تَعَالَ مُبَكِّرًا غَدًا، وَلَا تَأْتِ مُتَأَخِّرًا
sentences.transliteration: ta3aala mubakkiran ghadan, wa laa ta2ti muta2akhkhiraa

sentences.arabic: ابْنُكَ مُهَذَّبٌ وَذَكِيٌّ جِدًّا
sentences.transliteration: ibnuka muhadhdhabun wa dhakiyyun jiddaa

sentences.arabic: هَلْ تُرِيدُ الْقَمِيصَ الْأَحْمَرَ أَمِ الْأَزْرَقَ؟
sentences.transliteration: hal tureedu al-qameesa al-a7mara ami al-azraq?

sentences.arabic: السَّمَاءُ سَمَاوِيَّةٌ وَالْغُيُومُ بَيْضَاءُ
sentences.transliteration: as-samaa2u samaawiyyatun wal-ghuyoomu baydaa2

sentences.arabic: هَذِهِ الطَّاوِلَةُ مِنَ الْخَشَبِ، وَلَيْسَتْ مِنَ الْبِلَاسْتِيكِ
sentences.transliteration: haadhihi at-taawilatu mina al-khashabi, wa laysat mina al-plaasteek

sentences.arabic: أَحْضِرْ لِي الصَّحْنَ الْمُسْتَدِيرَ، لَا الْمُرَبَّعَ
sentences.transliteration: a7dir lee as-sa7na al-mustadeera, laa al-murabba3

sentences.arabic: قِلَادَتُهَا مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَخَاتَمُهَا مِنَ الْفِضَّةِ
sentences.transliteration: qilaadatuhaa mina adh-dhahabi wa khaatamuhaa mina al-fidda

sentences.arabic: اِنْتَبِهْ، هَذِهِ السِّكِّينُ حَادَّةٌ جِدًّا
sentences.transliteration: intabih, haadhihi as-sikkeenu 7aaddatun jiddaa

sentences.arabic: أَنَا سَعِيدٌ جِدًّا لِأَنَّكَ جِئْتَ
sentences.transliteration: anaa sa3eedun jiddan li2annaka ji2t

sentences.arabic: لِمَاذَا أَنْتَ حَزِينٌ؟ مَاذَا حَدَثَ؟
sentences.transliteration: limaadhaa anta 7azeen? maadhaa 7adath?

sentences.arabic: هِيَ مُضْطَرِبَةٌ قَبْلَ امْتِحَانِ الْغَدِ
sentences.transliteration: hiya mudtaribatun qabla imti7aani al-ghad

sentences.arabic: أَبُوكَ فَخُورٌ بِكَ جِدًّا
sentences.transliteration: abooka fakhoorun bika jiddaa

sentences.arabic: لَا تَكُنْ غَاضِبًا، كُنْتُ قَلِقًا عَلَيْكَ فَقَطْ
sentences.transliteration: laa takun ghaadiban, kuntu qaliqan 3alayka faqat

sentences.arabic: ضَحِكَ حَتَّى نَزَلَتِ الدُّمُوعُ مِنْ عَيْنَيْهِ
sentences.transliteration: da7ika 7attaa nazalati ad-dumoo3u min 3aynayh

sentences.arabic: جَارُنَا لَطِيفٌ وَصَادِقٌ
sentences.transliteration: jaarunaa lateefun wa saadiq

sentences.arabic: تَعَلُّمُ لُغَةٍ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى صَبْرٍ كَثِيرٍ
sentences.transliteration: ta3allumu lughatin ya7taaju ilaa sabrin katheer

sentences.arabic: هِيَ طَالِبَةٌ مُجْتَهِدَةٌ وَخَدُومَةٌ
sentences.transliteration: hiya taalibatun mujtahidatun wa khadooma

sentences.arabic: لَا تَكُنْ أَنَانِيًّا، شَارِكْ أَخَاكَ الطَّعَامَ
sentences.transliteration: laa takun anaaniyyan, shaarik akhaaka at-ta3aam

sentences.arabic: الْأَدَبُ الْحَسَنُ مُهِمٌّ فِي كُلِّ بَيْتٍ
sentences.transliteration: al-adabu al-7asanu muhimmun fee kulli bayt

sentences.arabic: جَدِّي رَجُلٌ حَكِيمٌ وَمُتَوَاضِعٌ
sentences.transliteration: jaddee rajulun 7akeemun wa mutawaadi3
